The scientist {npc:Spectulus}, of the Edron Academy, lost his intern {npc:Jack} in an experiment with a time machine. You help convince Jack of who he "really" is: you decorate his house with old furniture, talk to his family and destroy his sculpture. At the end you receive 6000 experience, a {item:Piece of Marble Rock} and one of two achievements, depending on whether you tell Jack the truth or lie to him.
